research_problem: Black-box REST fuzzers are rarely evaluated with code coverage, so their real limitations are unknown
technical_approach: 7 fuzzers x 19 SUTs x 10 runs x 1h with JaCoCo/c8 line coverage; EvoMaster white-box vs grey-box; manual source-code analysis of uncovered branches
primary_contribution: Coverage-based tool comparison plus a source-level catalogue of open problems in REST fuzzing
dataset_benchmark: 19 APIs from EMB (6 NodeJS, 13 JVM incl. 1 industrial), ~285K LOC
evaluation_metrics: Line coverage (JaCoCo/c8); detected faults (white-box only, EvoMaster-internal); Mann-Whitney U, Vargha-Delaney A12
baselines: bBOXRT, EvoMaster BB, RESTest, RestCT, RESTler, RestTestGen, Schemathesis
key_findings: Avg coverage: EvoMaster 56.8%, Schemathesis 54.5%, others 33.6-45.4%; no tool >60%; white-box +7.5% coverage but only +3.4 faults (<10%); white-box worse on ocvn-rest; open problems: faulty/underspecified schemas, non-JSON payloads, recursive schemas, external services (no fuzzer mocks), string/regex constraints, NoSQL, third-party @Valid constraints, auth/initial data, non-REST-compliant APIs
author_limitations: Authors built EvoMaster (bias); possible misconfiguration of other tools; 19 APIs; arbitrary 1h budget; compares implementations not techniques
analyst_limitations: EMB is EvoMaster's own benchmark (home advantage); authors repaired schemas for other tools; no black-box fault metric; dynamic auth not configured for 2 APIs; pre-LLM (2022)
reproducibility: Scripts in EvoMaster repo (Zenodo); SUTs in EMB except industrial ind0; ~71 days compute
suggested_extensions: Spec inference/enrichment for underspecified schemas; external-service mocking in fuzzers; NoSQL-aware generation; extract @Valid constraints; field-name-based type inference (possibly LLM)
evidence_location: RQs p.4 L201-204; Table 2 p.9; Table 4 p.11; open problems p.12-28 L1229-2361; threats p.28
integrity: arXiv v2 (19 APIs) differs from TOSEM version (20 APIs); tables column-split but recoverable; code figures letter-spaced
